import asyncio,json,time
import aiohttp
MODEL="qwen2.5-coder:1.5b-instruct-q4_K_M"
URL="http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/chat"
PS="http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/ps"
from open_webui.utils.session_pool import get_session,close_session,get_client_timeout
from open_webui.env import AIOHTTP_CLIENT_SESSION_SSL

def p(ref):
  return {"model":MODEL,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":f"Reply OK. Ref {ref}."}],"stream":False,"options":{"num_ctx":4096,"num_predict":1,"temperature":0}}

def rec(route,ref,t0,b,status):
  x={"route":route,"ref":ref,"status":status,"wall_ms":round((time.perf_counter()-t0)*1000,3)}
  for k in ("total_duration","load_duration","prompt_eval_duration","eval_duration","prompt_eval_count","eval_count"):
    if isinstance(b,dict) and k in b:x[k+"_ms" if k.endswith("_duration") else k]=round(b[k]/1e6,3) if k.endswith("_duration") else b[k]
  return x

async def direct(s,ref):
  t=time.perf_counter()
  async with s.post(URL,data=json.dumps(p(ref),separators=(",",":")),headers={"Content-Type":"application/json"},timeout=aiohttp.ClientTimeout(total=30)) as r:
    b=await r.json(); return rec("direct",ref,t,b,r.status)

async def owui(ref):
  s=await get_session();t=time.perf_counter()
  async with s.request("POST",URL,data=json.dumps(p(ref),separators=(",",":")),headers={"Content-Type":"application/json"},ssl=AIOHTTP_CLIENT_SESSION_SSL,timeout=get_client_timeout(False)) as r:
    b=await r.json(); return rec("owui_session_pool",ref,t,b,r.status)

async def ps(s):
  async with s.get(PS,timeout=aiohttp.ClientTimeout(total=5)) as r:return await r.json()

async def main():
  print("PHASE=cold_plus_warm_pair")
  print("MODEL="+MODEL)
  async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as s:
    print("PS_BEFORE="+json.dumps(await ps(s),separators=(",",":")))
    for item in (await direct(s,"cold"),await direct(s,"warm-direct"),await owui("warm-owui")):
      print("SAMPLE="+json.dumps(item,separators=(",",":")))
    print("PS_AFTER="+json.dumps(await ps(s),separators=(",",":")))
  await close_session()
asyncio.run(main())
PY
